data.one_liner: Display a list of world-wide countries, states, and cities depending on given country.
data.what_it_does: Provides asynchronous functions and models to fetch worldwide countries, states, and cities by ISO codes or names. It handles data structures for countries, states, cities, and time zones.
use_when: You need a picker or list of countries, states, and cities in your app.
You need to filter states and cities based on a selected country's ISO code.
avoid_when: You need offline-first local database persistence for user location changes.
You require detailed interactive maps and geolocation features.
strengths: Easy to query countries, states, and cities by ISO codes.
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Limited to static lists of countries, states, and cities.
Does not include UI picker widgets out of the box, only data/utilities.
